entry.title: Dwarf Fortress v2.0.1
entry.content:
Bugfix release. 2.0.0 seeds and worlds remain playable and installing this requires no regeneration - see **What carries over** for the two exceptions.
### Merchant's Shop
- **Goods you never bought were being marked as purchased.** Location checks fired for items left behind in the caravan's stock, permanently consuming those slots and releasing the items to their recipients for free. Two independent causes: - A good counted as sold the moment its item left the map - which is also exactly what happens when the caravan packs it up and takes it home. A sale now requires the item to still exist, to have its trader flag cleared, and to not be held by a merchant. - Cleanup of a departed caravan's goods ran on a docked-to-undocked transition held in memory, so a save/reload across the departure skipped it and stranded the bookkeeping. Those entries then sat untouched until the *next* caravan docked - a year later in one report - and were misread in a batch. Cleanup now runs on any idle tick, so nothing can be stranded. - Unbought goods left in a caravan's stock return to the rotation properly and come back around on a later visit. - Goods that a paused game failed to remove are retried, instead of being forgotten and left in the fortress permanently. - **Runtime naming and pricing of shop goods never actually ran.** The lookup that maps each slot to its material iterated `world.raws.inorganics`, but that is a struct whose list lives in `.all` - iterating the struct yields nothing and raises no error, so every slot looked absent. Goods fell back to unnamed iron at a flat price and the mod wrongly reported "this world's raws predate the shop materials" even on worlds that had them. Two other raws scans (diamond variants, sand for glassmaking) had the same defect and silently found nothing. - **Shop goods were selectable as a crafting material, and leaked the whole shop.** The per-slot materials carried `[IS_STONE]` and inherited `STONE_TEMPLATE`'s `[ITEMS_HARD]`/`[ITEMS_QUERN]`, so every good turned up in stone and hard-material pickers - "Make rock blocks" listed them between Alabaster and Andesite. Those entries show each good's **real multiworld item name**, so the entire shop could be read without buying anything. The materials now carry no usage flags at all, so nothing in game can select them.
### The Archipelago caravan
- **Establishing contact with the gorlaks was a single silent attempt.** It ran only on Merchant's Coffer #1, marked itself successful *before* checking whether the civilization even existed, and reported failure to the DFHack console alone — so a world without the Archipelago civ produced no caravan, no shop, and no visible explanation for the rest of the run. Contact is now recorded only when it actually succeeds, retried on each later coffer until it does, and both failure modes (no civ / summon failed) announce themselves in game. - **A world with no Archipelago civilization no longer quietly consumes your run.** With the shop enabled and no gorlak civ present - meaning the world was generated without the mod ticked in DF's world-gen mod list - the client refuses to bind the run's seed to that world and keeps saying why, while the mod raises a screen-stopping popup followed by repeating reminders. The world stays unbound, so the same multiworld seed is still usable once a correct world exists. - `dwarfipelago test worldcheck` now verifies the gorlak civilization exists, and notes that they must additionally be a **neighbor of your embark** to send caravans at all. - The setup guide gained a "Choosing an embark site" section, and an "If you got it wrong" table separating the two failure modes: a non-neighbor embark is fixed by **re-embarking elsewhere in the same world** (the seed is stored against the world, so the run carries over and received items are re-delivered), while a missing civ needs a new world. Neither was documented anywhere before.
### Logic and checks
- **Shield, Mace and Tactics skill checks never fired** - 45 locations dead, three skills at 15 tiers each. The skill flag is maintained in two places, `df_item` in the apworld's `locations.py` and `skill` in the mod's `checks.lua`, and three of them disagreed by a letter (`shieldwarf`/`shielddwarf`, `macedwarf`/`macerdwarf`, `tatics`/`tactics`). The client derives the storage key it polls from the seed, so it was watching an address the mod never wrote to: no error, just silence. All 87 flags are now verified identical on both sides, and each list carries a comment explaining the coupling. - **The Checks tab showed Mined Adamantine as reachable with no mining depth.** The in-game tracker builds its options from `slot_data`, and its mapping table never listed `mining_depth`; unmapped options read as 0, so the adamantine rule took its "no depth system" branch and returned true outright. `trades_inlogic` had the same hole and was missing from `slot_data` entirely. Both are carried through now, and the table documents why anything a rule branches on has to be listed.
### Traps
- **The Lost Caravan trap no longer blanket-mutates every trade good.** It set `flags.rotten` on *all* trader items - 400+ bars, stones and cages in one report — on the untested assumption that this was "inert on non-organic goods", and set wear on items that cannot be worn. Rot is now limited to genuinely perishable item types and wear to wearable ones, and caged livestock is killed the way DFHack's own `destroyUnit` does it, since draining blood alone does not reliably finish a unit.
### Install
- **The mod was searching for in the wrong folder.** The DF data root was taken as `dirname(game_path)`, but `game_path` may legitimately point at `dfhack.exe` - and the standalone DFHack Steam app lives in `.../common/DFHack/hack/`, nowhere near DF. The client now locates the real DF base folder by looking for DF's own markers, then by checking the sibling install in the same Steam library.
### What carries over
| | | |---|---| | **Applies to existing seeds immediately** | Every Merchant's Shop fix, the Checks tab fix, caravan contact, the missing-civ failsafe, and the Mace skill checks — all client- and mod-side. | | **Needs a regenerated seed** | Shield and Tactics. Their flag lives in the apworld and is baked into `slot_data` at generation, so those 30 locations stay dead on a seed rolled under 2.0.0. | | **Needs a regenerated world** | The shop-material fix. Raws are written into a save at world generation, so an existing world keeps the selectable, name-leaking materials. | | **Cannot be recovered** | Shop slots already consumed by a false purchase. Those checks are server-side truth once sent. |

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.16.0
entry.content: ## Changes The Docker stack gets the launcher's browser interface, five new ways to pay checks, and the bugs that came with running the stack on a plain Docker Engine. Nothing here changes a run in progress: a seed keeps the options it was made with. Bots at 0.15.2. ### The admin page - **A browser interface for Compose.** `docker compose up -d` now serves the same page the native launcher opens, on **http://127.0.0.1:8477**: the run and its missions, what the multiworld has unlocked, your bot team, and the server and bridge logs with the search over them. `docker compose logs admin` prints the address, and `TF2AP_ADMIN_PORT` in `.env` moves it. - It stays on loopback, because the page can send server commands. For a server on another machine, forward it: `ssh -L 8477:127.0.0.1:8477 user@host`. - Docker keeps the server's lifecycle. Start, Stop and Restart print the Compose command to run rather than pretending to do it themselves: the page has no Docker socket, and giving it one would give it the whole host. - The Settings tab writes `.env`, the file Compose already reads, keeping its comments and everything in it the launcher does not own. Settings the containers read apply on `docker compose up -d --force-recreate`; seed options apply the next time the seed runs. - **Join address.** A setting for the address the Join button hands to players. Blank discovers a local one. Name your public IP or DNS for a forwarded server, or the WSL address when Docker runs in WSL and TF2 runs on Windows. - Community packs download from the page, with the progress on the page rather than buried in the log, and the running server picks the extracted files up within about thirty seconds. Nothing to rebuild. - SigMod ships in the image, and the page now recognises it as installed instead of offering to install what is already there. - **Tailscale needs no auth key.** Set up / check Funnel signs the bundled service in through a link in the browser, and the login survives restarts in a volume of its own. Its Compose profile and `TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY` are both gone; the switch on its own is enough. ### More checks, without more missions Five options, all off by default. Each one adds checks to a seed, so a short run has something to fill it and a long one has more to find. - **Victory caches.** A mission clear is worth checks scaled by its tier: one at normal, two at intermediate, three at advanced, five at expert and haunted. - **Milestone checks.** Running totals over the whole run, whatever mission they happened in: robots, giants and tanks destroyed. Something to grind when a wave will not fall. - **Giantsanity** and **Tanksanity.** A check for every giant, and for every tank, of every wave, beside the mission's own first of each. The counts come out of Valve's own mission files, so community missions pay only their first. Empire Escalation alone holds eighty-two giants, Cataclysm eleven tanks. - **Weapon slots per class.** Each class earns its own two slots instead of one item opening a slot for everybody, and its first slot comes free with the class: the Medigun for a Medic, the Knife for a Spy. Eighteen items in the pool where there were three, so a run with few missions may not fit them. ### The tracker has an address - The visual campaign tracker is published at . Paste a room or tracker link and share the page; nobody has to host it. ### The bots The mod moves to 0.15.2. - The mercenaries stopped shouting over each other in the break. A bot pressed ready on every frame the game refused one, which is every frame for the first seconds after a wave ends, and every press spoke its Ready line. It presses once a second now. - In the Docker stack they stopped moving after a map change. The navigation they read was emptied by the changelevel and nothing filled it again, so only a restart brought them back. By kelly-cs. ### Fixed - The Docker stack finds the Steam relay address, the way the launcher started doing in v1.14.0: from the server's own console file, the only place it lands. Join could say "waiting" for a whole session on a relay server that was working perfectly. - On Docker Engine the page could not save anything at all: every Save and every pack download failed with a permission error. Docker Desktop hides the file ownership behind it, so testing there never hit it. - Saving any setting, against a multiworld hosted inside the stack, turned TLS on for it. The bridge then never reconnected. - A stack that kept the example's `MVM_START_MISSION=random` could not generate a seed. It had been refusing since v1.11.0. - A crash in the container leaves a `debug.log` with a stack in it. The image asked the server for one and had no debugger to produce it. - Admins listed in `.env` got no permissions until somebody reloaded the admin cache by hand. The server is told about the list as soon as it is written. - Test mode left missions locked until the starting inventory arrived, so the first map change could be refused. - A mission drawn with zero modifiers still drew one. - Weapon buffs offered flags the weapon already carries, and five weapons were offered buffs that do nothing on them. A buff in the pool now changes something on the weapon it names. - Max health buffs followed the class rather than the player holding them. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(docker): make the Compose admin workflow usable by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/84 * fix(gamedata): a flag the weapon already carries is not a buff by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/87 * fix(apworld): a mission draws no modifier when the draw is zero by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/86 * fix(buffs): max health follows the player, and five pools lose inert buffs by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/88 * feat: milestone checks, running totals over the whole run by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/90 * feat: weapon slots per class, each class earning its own two by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/91 * Publish the visual campaign tracker on GitHub Pages by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/93 * fix(web): align empty mission action cells by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/94 * fix(test-mode): unlock every listed mission by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/95 * fix(docker): reload SourceMod admins after install by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/97 * feat: victory caches, a mission clear worth checks scaled by its tier by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/89 * feat: giantsanity and tanksanity, a check for every giant and tank of every wave by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/92 * fix(tracker): show per-class weapon slots by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/100 * fix(docker): restore defender navigation after map changes by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/102 * build(bots): bump defender plugin for silent readiness by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/99 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.15.0...v1.16.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZGZkNzcxYzg5NWVmNWU0NGI0ZjE4YTg3MzViOGMxMmQ6MTc4OTU1NzI1Nw==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ODkxZDhmYmQ3ZWI3OWE5OTFiZWY5NTg3ZDZlNTE4M2Y6MTc4OTU1NzI1OQ==/detection)

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.6.0
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer.** The apworld now ships the `archipelago.json` manifest that Archipelago 0.7.0 will require, which also clears the "Invalid or missing manifest file" warning on generation. - **Regenerate your yaml.** The five "Classes required for ..." options changed meaning: they now count your starting class, so the range is 0-8 and a value of 1 means "no extra classes needed". An old yaml still generates, it just asks for one class fewer than it used to.
## Changes
### APWorld
- Volcano and Mountaintop no longer forget to require their own stage unlock. Generation was free to place "Unlock Volcano" inside Volcano, which made the seed impossible. - With Class Randomizer off, the class requirements are now sent to the client as 0. They were sent raw, so the client demanded 2-6 classes you could never get and every boss stage stayed out of logic forever. - Class requirements are clamped so a later boss never asks for fewer classes than an earlier one, and the clamped values are what the client receives. - Goal-based location exclusion now works. It compared location names against item names, so it never excluded anything. - Packaged with Archipelago's own "Build APWorlds" component: manifest included, no stale __pycache__ in the archive (98 KB -> 30 KB). - Rewritten to current Archipelago world conventions, with item and location name groups and a grouped player-options page. - Real logic tests plus CI on every push.
### Client
- The world map's stage colours now match Archipelago's logic. Six things were wrong: - tallies counted stages **beaten** instead of unlocks **held**; - the town/boss/goal stage lists never matched, so Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid and Mountaintop counted as ordinary region stages; - Opening Street counted towards the Castle gate despite having no unlock; - region gates hung off "boss beaten" instead of that boss's own requirements, so beating a boss early opened the next region; - boss gates never required their own stage unlock; - the unlocked-class list grew on every reconnect, so class gates were effectively always satisfied. - A stage dot no longer inherits the previous stage's colour. - archipelago.js 2.0.4 -> 2.1.0, vite 6 -> 8.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.7.0
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer.** The apworld now ships the `archipelago.json` manifest that Archipelago 0.7.0 will require, which also clears the "Invalid or missing manifest file" warning on generation. - **Regenerate your yaml.** Two options changed meaning since 1.5.0: - `traps` now takes `none / 5 / 10 / 20 / 50 / 100`. The old `some`, `half`, `most` and `all` are gone, so an old yaml fails generation with an unknown-value error rather than silently doing something different. - the five "Classes required for ..." options now count your starting class, so the range is 0-8 and 1 means "no extra classes needed". - Item names are now capitalised and carry their tier, e.g. `lightsaber` is `Lightsaber 2`. If your yaml names items in `start_inventory` or `local_items`, update them.
## New options
- **Shop Checks** — buying each of the 462 shop items for the first time is a check. The shop shows an Archipelago logo until you have collected it, and the real item afterwards. Buying drops the logo on the floor; leave town without picking it up and the check does not count (the gold is still spent). - **Progressive Shop** — the shop's stock is opened by 32 Progressive Shop items instead of by beating stages, in every town rather than just the first. - **Free Respec** — the Forget Tree is always free, not only with Class Randomizer on.
## Changes
### APWorld
- Volcano and Mountaintop no longer forget to require their own stage unlock. Generation was free to place "Unlock Volcano" inside Volcano, which made the seed impossible. - With Class Randomizer off, the class requirements are now sent to the client as 0. They were sent raw, so the client demanded 2-6 classes you could never get and every boss stage stayed out of logic forever. - Class requirements are clamped so a later boss never asks for fewer classes than an earlier one, and the clamped values are what the client receives. - The boss requirements rolled at generation are handed back to Universal Tracker, so the tracker stops rolling its own numbers and disagreeing with the seed about what is in logic. - Four lightsabers shared one name, and the item table is keyed by name, so three of them could never be created or sent. Names now carry their tier. - Goal-based location exclusion now works. It compared location names against item names, so it never excluded anything. - Packaged with Archipelago's own "Build APWorlds" component: manifest included, no stale `__pycache__` in the archive. - Rewritten to current Archipelago world conventions, with item and location name groups and a grouped player-options page.
### Client
- The world map's stage colours now match Archipelago's logic. Six things were wrong: - tallies counted stages **beaten** instead of unlocks **held**; - the town/boss/goal stage lists never matched, so Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid and Mountaintop counted as ordinary region stages; - Opening Street counted towards the Castle gate despite having no unlock; - region gates hung off "boss beaten" instead of that boss's own requirements, so beating a boss early opened the next region; - boss gates never required their own stage unlock; - the unlocked-class list grew on every reconnect, so class gates were effectively always satisfied.
If you previously saw Mountaintop and Volcano sitting yellow while Universal Tracker disagreed, or Submarine Shrine in logic while Submarine 4 was not, those should be gone. Please report it if you still see either. - **Level 99 is reachable again.** The guard that stops a kill granting two levels assumed the XP curve continued past level 98, and capped the team at 4,949,999 when reaching 99 needs 9,999,999. - **Town is no longer a softlock.** Reviving required someone already standing, leaving town needs a living ranger to walk to the sign, and Game Over only restores LP inside a stage — so a party wiped in town by the Kill a Ranger trap was stuck for good. A wiped party can revive now, free if it cannot pay. - Item names in the message log are coloured by flag bits, so an item that is both progression and useful no longer renders as filler. - The Gold Medal multiplies the gold multiplier instead of being added to it: 5x with a +100% medal is 10x, not 6x. - The Bronze Medal raises the AP check drop rate as well as normal loot. - The spawn-enemies trap no longer spawns diggers, which could burrow away unkillable. - The Forget Tree is genuinely free with Class Randomizer on; it charged $1. - Connection details are remembered between sessions. - Mouse and touch handlers use `addEventListener`, so browser extensions that assign `document.on*` can no longer break the game. Thanks to **SunsetQuasar** ([#1](https://github.com/Kryen112/Kryen112.github.io/pull/1)). - archipelago.js 2.0.4 -> 2.1.0, vite 6 -> 8.

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.16.1
entry.content: ## Changes ### Weapon slots, found in any order - **Weapon slots per class is now three ways, not two.** Off is one progressive item for everybody. Progressive is what v1.16.0 shipped: an item per class, opening that class's slots in its own order. **Any order** is the same eighteen slots as items that name them, found in whatever order the multiworld puts them in, so a Scout can find his melee before his secondary. - Safe because the slot a class is played with still comes free with the class: the Medigun for a Medic, the Knife for a Spy. Nobody is left holding only their worst weapon. - The items read as what they are: "Spy Revolver Slot" in somebody else's spoiler log, rather than a progressive item nobody outside the run can place. - Same eighteen items either way, so a run needs no more room for them than it did. A yaml saying `true` still means progressive. ### Fixed - A mission whose file this server does not have is said so and skipped, rather than loading its map and sitting on wave 0 for ever. TF2 ignores a mission file it cannot find and keeps the map's own, so a run that drew a community mission without the pack that carries it stopped dead with nothing saying why. `!missions` marks those `[not installed]`. ### The bots have names you choose - **A Names section on the Bots page.** The bots draw from a pool of names as they take their seats, and the pool is yours: add your own, and leave out any of the ones this launcher ships. The list is kept as what you changed rather than as a copy, so names added in a later release still reach you. - It works the same in the Docker stack, through `SRCDS_BOT_NAMES_EXCLUDED` and `SRCDS_BOT_NAMES_ADDED` in `.env`. - **A name for a seat.** Seat 3 can be called Gravel Pit Gary every run: the bot that sits there is given the name instead of drawing one. The rest of the seats keep drawing. - Renaming a seat costs the team nothing. The bots are renamed where they stand, rather than rebuilt: a new team would lose the upgrades it had bought, which is a steep price for a change of name. Bots at 0.16.0. - The pool itself is read when a map starts, so adding or removing a name reaches the bots on the next mission. ### Fixed - In the Docker stack the bots played stock weapons whatever the admin page said. The loadouts reached `.env` and stopped there: nothing wrote the file the mod reads, and nothing turned on the setting that makes it read one. A loadout built on the Loadouts page was also forgotten at the next restart, because `.env` is the whole of what the page remembers and the built ones were never written to it. - A team saved on the admin page was forgotten the same way, for the same reason. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.16.0...v1.16.1 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/Yjg2NmNlMDA1OGNhM2JmODkwNWNlMTYxNzI0NDNkZDk6MTc4OTU4OTc0MQ==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ODAyODkyNDFhNjhlYTBiYTFkZGExMzE0MmZmODk1ZTc6MTc4OTU4OTc0Mw==/detection)

entry.title: Pokemon HGSS v0.9.0r2
entry.content:
# Pokemon HeartGold / SoulSilver APWorld - v0.2.4-hotfix
Bug-fix release on top of v0.2.4, based on playtester reports. **Compatible with games already in progress**
## How to update
1. Replace `pokemon_hgss.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder with the one attached below. 2. Re-open your existing `.apheartgold` file as usual. Your save is kept.
- **Client fixes** apply as soon as the apworld is updated. - **ROM fixes** apply when you re-open your `.apheartgold` with this version. - **Logic fixes** only affect newly generated seeds.
## Fixes
### Logic (new seeds) - **Cliff Edge Gate no longer requires Rock Climb.** The gate between Cianwood and Route 47 is a plain walk-through: only the Secret Potion is needed, as in vanilla. Route 47, Route 48 and their checks are no longer pushed to the late game. - **Dead seeds through the Magnet Train.** The train also needs the Kanto Power Plant repaired, which the logic ignored (a real seed put HM03 Surf on Route 12). - `magnet_train` on (default): the Power Plant counts as repaired from the start. The train works as soon as you have the Pass, and the Machine Part quest is skipped along with its TM57 location. Requires the matching client. - `magnet_train` off: the train only counts once the Power Plant has really been repaired. - **The Copycat's Pass** now requires the Power Plant repair when `magnet_train` is off, since her Lost Item only appears after it. - **Bell Tower and Lugia monks.** The monks never check your bag: each one only lets you through once the NPC who hands out that wing has done so. The logic now requires talking to that NPC: - HeartGold: the Radio Tower director (Goldenrod) for the Rainbow Wing, the old man in Pewter City for the Silver Wing. - SoulSilver: the other way round.
Both wings are now merely useful items.
### Client (games in progress included) - **Goal is now reported to the server**, so "release on goal" and other goal-based settings finally trigger. This covers `elite_four`, `champion_red` and `n_badges`. - **Vermilion Gym could become impossible** if the Thunder Badge arrived before beating Lt. Surge. The client now hides the badge while you are in Vermilion City or its gym, until Surge is beaten. If you are stuck inside the gym, walk out and back in. - **Whiteout sent you back to New Bark** with `randomize_start_location` before your first Pokemon Center visit. You now wake up at your starting town's Pokemon Center. This fix only works on seeds generated with this version.
### ROM (re-open your .apheartgold) - **The Pass trade chain could break.** The Fan Club chairman refused the Lost Item if you already held a Pass, and the Copycat could stop offering her trade after your first talk. - **HeartGold: the Pewter City old man always gave a real Silver Wing** instead of the item placed there.
## Workarounds for games in progress - **Stuck at a wing monk:** talk to the NPC who hands out that wing in your version (listed above), even if you already hold the wing. - **Stuck by the Magnet Train on an older seed:** ask the host for the missing item (`/send` or `!getitem`).

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.0
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **A game already in progress will lose its map colours.** The website updates for everyone at once, and from now on the seed itself tells the client what is in logic. A seed generated before 1.8.0 does not carry that, so its stages show simply as unlocked or completed. Everything else keeps working, and a new seed gets the colours back. - **Regenerate your yaml** for the new options below. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## New options
- **Enforce Logic** — stages that are out of logic cannot be entered at all. They stay on the map, greyed out, so you can still see what you hold. There is no override: the run cannot be broken by accident or on purpose. - **Ring Link** — your gold is linked to every other Ring Link player's rings. Gold you earn sends rings to the room, rings you receive become gold, and spending sends a negative. **Ring Link Ratio** (default 100) sets how much gold one ring is worth in both directions, because Stick Ranger's gold is one to two orders of magnitude larger than the ring counts games like Sonic deal in. - **Gold per Thrown Ring** — every ring an Angel throws pays gold. Defaults to 50, and goes up to 1000. Set it to 0 to turn it off. It ignores the Gold Multiplier and the Gold Medal, so the number you pick is the number you get. Be aware that an Angel throws about two rings a second, or seven on a quick ring, and four of them at the maximum out-earns every enemy in the game.
## Changes
### Logic now comes from the seed
The website used to carry its own copy of the apworld's rules, written by hand and kept in step by hand. That is what went wrong six different ways in 1.6.0.
The apworld now describes its own logic and sends it with the seed, and the website evaluates that instead of a copy. There is no second set of rules left to drift. Checked by comparing 25,500 stage verdicts against Archipelago's own answer across 300 random item states.
This is why an older seed loses its colours: it never sent a description.
### APWorld
- Universal Tracker gets the boss requirements the seed actually rolled, so it stops rolling its own and disagreeing with the game. - New: Enforce Logic, Ring Link, Ring Link Ratio, Gold per Thrown Ring.
### Client
- Every movement of gold now goes through one place, which is what Ring Link watches. What it reports is what actually happened, so a purchase you could not afford or a pickup at the gold cap sends nothing. - Ring Link batches: gold moves constantly here, so instead of a packet per change it totals up and sends at most one every five seconds. The total is added up before being divided, so ten $40 gun shots count as 4 rings rather than ten lots of nothing, and the remainder carries to the next send. - Gold arriving from Ring Link is never sent back out, so two linked Stick Ranger players cannot amplify each other.

Because this version is meant for testing, the mod must be installed/updated manually.
To use this version in a new mod profile, look for an option to import a local mod. r2modman users can find this option under Settings > Profile > Import local mod. Gale users can find the option under Import > ..local mod. If your mod manager does not automatically install the required dependencies, you will need to install the latest versions of BepInEx, Archipelago Scrap, and DawnLib.
To use this version in an existing mod profile, navigate to wherever you have this mod installed, delete the old APLC.dll, and replace it with the version in the attached .zip file. r2modman users can find their profile folder by clicking Settings -> Browse profile folder, and Gale users can find it under File -> Open profile folder. From there, navigate to BepInEx/plugins/APLC-APLC and you should see APLC.dll. For users of Gale Mod Manager, it is especially important to DELETE the old dll FIRST to avoid overwriting the mod in other profiles.

Apworld: * changed moon checks to grade locations (ex. 'Vow check 1' is now 'Vow Grade Location 1') * for the sake of clarity, locations and items are no longer referred to as 'checks' anywhere in the mod or apworld * reworked the Collectathon goal * it now requires the player to collect an assortment of random scrap in addition to the ap chests * players can now set min_scrap_chance and min_monster_chance to 0 without encountering issues * fixed a logic issue where rare scrap and monsters could still have certain progression items
Known issues: * If a player connects to a slot that has modify_scrap_spawns, scrap spawns will remain modified for until the player closes the game, even if the player opens a different save file. * if another mod grants extra inventory slots, those slots are not usable

entry.title: Wario Land 3 v0.7.0
entry.content:
This is a BIG update with A LOT of new features/fixes. This has been tested, but since it's such a big update, there may be (and probably will be) some bugs. It shouldn't be anything gamebreaking, but please let me know if there is. I will label this a pre-release until we've done a bit more testing. This shouldn't be brought to public syncs just yet, but I will add it as stable when it should be.
## New Features
### Shopsanity Adds an entirely new shop to the right of the temple! The options for this include different price tiers: cheap, normal and expensive. Each have weighted prices with 2 at the lower end, 2 towards the top, and 6 in the middle. (There's currently no hard set logic for these checks, as you're able to grind out coins in level as needed).
### New Victory Condition Adds the 10 bosses as a potential win condition. There is also a new option of "bosses_required" (similar to music_boxes_required) where you can choose how many bosses you want as your win condition. This CAN be used in conjunction with boss_defeats granting items.
### Hidden blocks and coins Added a new option under "hidden_blocks_revealed" to ALSO color guaranteed coin blocks differently than normal blocks. This will be useful for grinding out coins... and maybe for something in the future? 👀
## QoL Updates
### Temple update - You can now enter the temple before being able to beat Rudy. He will tell you how many bosses/music boxes you have left before you can fight him.
### Pause Menu Treasure Tracker - Updated the treasure count at the top of the treasure tracker to dynamically show how many locations you've checked (i.e. 10/410). - Replaced the page count at the top right with the win condition requirements you've collected so far. - Added multiple new pages to the treasure tracker menu: - Musical Coin tracker - Keys, bosses and chests tracker (tracks how many you've collected per level) - Transformations treasure page - Shows your "Owned Keys" per level, so you can see what keys you have (G R G B = Grey, Red, Green, Blue)
### Misc.
- Keys are now their vanilla sprites, with a large ACTUALLY readable letter/number for their corresponding level. - Changed a few palettes for in-game text, as well as increasing the text size to be more uniform. - Roll/ice skatin' without transformations on now returns them back to their vanilla states (can't turn) - Pauses are now allowed in boss rooms, so on the off-chance you get soft locked, you can return to the overworld. - Palette shuffle updates to include more saturation randomization. This helps with the lack of colors to choose from, adds a bit more variety. - Crests now replaced by coins. 1 Coin = 1 Coin, 2 slimmer coins = 10, 3 sideways coins = 25 and 4 sideways coins = 50. - Made some yaml changes for conciseness
### Bug Fixes - Scowler blocks finally fixed. - Gold magic spawning waves in N1 fixed. - Glass Eyes door, Golden eyes door and fence all adjusted in Tower of Revival to look as they should if you do not own their items. - Vast Plains finally don't have empty space when you have chemicals but no magic seeds. Coin 6 still needs chemicals or magic seeds to spawn. - Cave of Flames now actually shows rusted blocks correctly, regardless of variant. - Removed a few dust/particles that were still being overwritten by lettering. - Overworld crash now gated so you can't spam right or left in the transition. Should no longer crash - Large blocks are now breakable from above without Garlic. - You should no longer get spammed with item popups after re-connecting. - Probably so much more that I'm forgetting
### Lizzie's Logic Fixes
- Out of the Woods Coin 3 now requires Puffy Form - Added flying past the climbable fencing back to Tower of Revival - Added rolling past currents into easy glitches logic - Added using the blue key/chest door to get past the warps without warp removal apparatus into knowledge check logic - Added getting Castle of Illusions coins 2 and 3 via wall jump to all glitches logic

entry.title: Brotato v0.15.0r2
entry.content:
## Added - New Feature: Progressive Wave Caps - The game now has a cap on the highest wave that can be played from the start. - A set of new items, "Progressive Wave Cap (\<character\>)", has been added which, when received, increases the maximum playable wave for each character. - The logic for Wave Completed and Run Won locations now requires that the wave cap be greater than the wave number or 20, respectively. - Controlled by a new option, `wave_caps`, which sets the number Progressive Wave Cap Increase items for each character and the increase given by each one. - There are predefined values for `wave_caps`: - `one`: One wave cap, all 20 waves are reachable from the start (matches previous apworld behavior). - `two`: Waves 1-10 are playable from the start, waves 11-20 require a cap increase. - `four`: Waves 1-5 are playable from the start, 6-10 require a single increase, 11-15 require two, 16-20 require three. - `ten`: Waves 1-2 are playable from the start, 3-4 require one increase, etc. - `twenty`: Every wave past wave 1 requires a cap increase. - Added Universal Tracker hooks to the apworld so it now uses the same characters as the actual slot.
## Changed
- Reduced the maximum values of some options that were unfun at larger values: - `num_victories` is now 25 instead of matching the total number of characters. - `num_common_crate_drops` is now 25 instead of 50. - `num_legendary_crate_drops` is now 10 instead of 50. - The amount of wins to unlock each group of loot crate checks has been adjusted so the thresholds are evenly distributed over the number of wins needed to goal. - Before, the last group could be unlocked much earlier in logic if the number of groups did not evenly divide into the number of wins needed.

APWORLD (needed for generating archieplago game): - Have Archipelago Launcher Installed (latest release found here: https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest ) - Download Spirit Valley APWorld (See Releases for latest version) - Select "Install APWorld" in launcher and select Hunie Cam Studio APWorld you downloaded - Restart launcher for APWorld to properly install - (Optional but Recomended)Select "Generate Template Options" to generate default Hunie Cam Studio YMAL
